2.name: TXD
2.hint: serial data output, high when idle (p. 5)

4.name: V3

needs.source: WCH CH340 Datasheet (CH340DS1), English version 3C, p. 3 (pin table: 'requires an external 0.1uF power decoupling capacitor') and p. 10 (C9 0.1 µF) – 0.1 µF read as the minimum: assumption

hints: CH340C: built-in clock – no crystal and no oscillator capacitors (p. 1, p. 2, p. 5); pin 7 stays open; transmit baud-rate error < 1.2 % (p. 7)
operating ambient −20 … +70 °C for the CH340C; −40 … +85 °C only for CH340C lots starting with 4 (English 3C, p. 8 – the Chinese 3D lists −20 … +70 °C only)

two supply modes (p. 5): 5 V – VCC 4.0–5.3 V, V3 only to a 0.1 µF capacitor; 3.3 V – V3 joined to VCC and every circuit on the CH340's I/O at most 3.3 V. Between 3.6 V and 4.0 V the data sheet specifies neither; vdd_op_min_v … vdd_op_max_v spans both modes and does not see that gap

the I/O pins are not 5 V tolerant on a 3.3 V supply (VIO ≤ VCC + 0.5 V, p. 8) except CH340C/N of lot numbers starting with 4 and the CH340X (p. 5); a 5 V-supplied CH340 drives 5 V into a 3.3 V microcontroller's RX

powered separately from the microcontroller, current flows back through the I/O pins; the data sheet's dual supply circuits (7.7, p. 13) add diodes and an NMOS – or power both from one supply (7.6, p. 12)
input thresholds differ by supply: VIH ≥ 2.3 V / VIL ≤ 0.9 V at 5 V, VIH ≥ 1.9 V / VIL ≤ 0.8 V at 3.3 V (p. 8–9); the entry holds the stricter pair, 2.3 V and 0.8 V

notes: No behaviour model (behavior none): the simulation draws no supply current. V3 is typed passive: it is an internal node with a capacitor in 5 V operation and a supply input in 3.3 V operation – power_in would make the 5 V wiring PATH.unfed, power_output the 3.3 V wiring LVL.contention.

CH340C needs no crystal (p. 2, p. 5); pin 7 must stay open (p. 3)
abs. max VCC 6.0 V, VIO VCC + 0.5 V, TA −20 … 70 °C (p. 8)
VCC 4.0–5.3 V (5 V mode) and 3.1–3.6 V (3.3 V mode); ICC ≤ 20 mA; VIH/VIL per supply (p. 8–9)
0.1 µF at VCC and at V3 (p. 3, p. 5, p. 10); UD± without series resistors (p. 2–3)
same values in the Chinese edition 3D (p. 2–3, p. 5)
